name: Better Hitbox Trail
description: This mod adds customizable hitbox trail settings and a mod menu.

trail-capture-rate.name: Trail Capture Rate
trail-capture-rate.description: Number of hitbox positions recorded per second. Only divisors of 240 are allowed so spacing stays even.

hitbox-between-frames.name: Hitbox Between Frames
hitbox-between-frames.description: When using CBF or CBS, this also records a hitbox position at the exact sub-tick moment a click/release occurs. Turn off to only record hitbox positions on regular game ticks, since sub-tick hitboxes aren't actual collision points. (except if you die in a frame with CBF applied)

blue-hitbox-color-clicks.name: Blue Hitbox Color Clicks
blue-hitbox-color-clicks.description: Applies the Click, Release and hold colors to the blue hitbox when clicked.

square-hitbox-color.name: Square Hitbox Color
square-hitbox-color.description: Color of the main square hitbox outline.

blue-hitbox-color.name: Blue Hitbox Color
blue-hitbox-color.description: Color of the internal blue hitbox outline.

circle-hitbox-color.name: Circle Hitbox Color
circle-hitbox-color.description: Color of the circle hitbox outline.

rotation-hitbox-color.name: Rotation Hitbox Color
rotation-hitbox-color.description: Color of the rotation hitbox outline.
